groups.description: DSAEK in eyes with surgically treated glaucoma (trabeculectomy, trabeculectomy followed by tube shunt, or trabeculotomy). Indication from the abstract conclusion ('DSAEK for bullous keratopathy after glaucoma surgery'). Methods: no eye of this group had phacoemulsification at the DSAEK operation.

DSAEK in eyes with medically treated glaucoma. Indications are not tabulated per group; the article states the cohort included FECD and pseudophakic/aphakic bullous keratopathy. Phacoemulsification with IOL implantation followed by DSAEK in the same operation in 2 of the 17 eyes (combined left null: only part of the group).

DSAEK in eyes without glaucoma. Indications are not tabulated per group; the article states the cohort included FECD and pseudophakic/aphakic bullous keratopathy. Phacoemulsification with IOL implantation followed by DSAEK in the same operation in 39 of the 132 eyes (combined left null: only part of the group).

exclusions.reason: same preoperative reference as the Table 2 Preop row; the Table 2 row is cited so that each series comes from one table

exclusions.what: Graft survival (Kaplan-Meier, Figure 2), Cox model (Table 6), aqueous humor protein and cytokines (Table 4), clinical-factor correlations (Table 5)

notes: Prospective consecutive case series: 181 eyes of 181 patients who underwent DSAEK from October 2015 to August 2019, stratified before surgery by glaucoma status (surgically treated, medically treated, none); examinations preoperatively and at 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 years. Exclusions were preoperative (active corneal or anterior chamber inflammation, systemic steroid therapy); no minimum follow-up criterion is stated.
The whole cohort is not tabulated; the three glaucoma-status groups are extracted as separate control groups.
43 eyes had graft failure within 6 years and 2 eyes had graft rejection; the article imputes 300 cells/mm2 as ECD for failed grafts and does not state how failed grafts enter the acuity means.
Endothelial cell density (Table 3), IOP, axial length and central corneal thickness (Table 1) are tabulated: notes only. Uncorrected acuity is not reported.
